gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: He ended ___ selling insurance, though he'd trained as a chef.
gaps.explanation: end up = finally be in a place/situation/state.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your toys when you've finished playing.
gaps.explanation: put away = put something in its usual place.

gaps.sentence: This old house needs doing ___ before winter.
gaps.explanation: do up = repair and decorate a building. (British usage)

gaps.sentence: Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.
